summary: Tested feature batch 4 (square uploads, multi-scheme per variant incl. case_price, per-variant images, admin schemes list toggle/search, admin create/edit/delete orders, regressions). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_batch4_features.py — square upload returns padded WebP with equal width/height; non-square param still resizes to <=1600w; multi-scheme (free_qty 10+2 + special_price 95) coexist on same variant with free_qty=2 AND unit_price=95; when a lower special (88) is added it wins; case_price scheme_type 80 with min 12 wins at qty 12 but falls back to 88 at qty 10; GET /api/products/nerviphos-bm variant.active_schemes lists ALL four TEST schemes with types free_qty/special_price/case_price; variant.images array persists through PUT /api/admin/products/{id} and GET returns them; admin create order returns VM-2026-##### with 'created by admin' activity and appears in listing; PUT recomputes totals with 'edited' activity; DELETE removes order and next GET is 404; regression NERVIPHOS-BM NBM-100 qty10 still yields free_qty=5. Frontend: admin login OK; /admin/schemes has scheme-search (filters rows), scheme-toggle-<id> switches (role=switch, click flips data-state), edit-scheme-<id> present, NO delete-scheme buttons (confirmed via DOM inspection); scheme dialog sf-type dropdown exposes three options including 'Case Price (buy full case)'; /admin/orders shows admin-create-order button and delete-order-<orderNumber> buttons per row; create-order-dialog opens, co-name/co-mobile/co-add-item/co-product-0/co-variant-0/co-qty-0/co-submit all work AFTER fixing setRow stale-closure bug — order created (toast success, dialog closes, row appears when searching by mobile), delete-order flow shows AlertDialog with Cancel/Delete and successfully removes the row.

ui_bugs.issue: For scheme_type='case_price', the row's Rule/Type columns render as free_qty branch ('undefined+undefined') because the ternary only checks 'special_price'. Cosmetic — case_price rows in the list will display incorrectly until logic includes case_price.

integration_issues.issue: CreateOrderDialog.setRow used a stale form.items closure and setForm without functional updater, so two synchronous setRow calls in the product select's onValueChange (setRow product_id, setRow variant_id='') overwrote each other and the product selection never persisted — blocking the entire admin-create-order flow via UI. Fixed by rewriting setRow to use setForm(f => ({...f, items: f.items.map(...)})). Backend endpoint itself was never broken.

action_items: Update AdminSchemes.jsx row rendering to handle scheme_type === 'case_price' in the Type column ('Case Price') and Rule column (e.g. `${min_quantity} @ ₹${special_price}` / case), otherwise case_price schemes will show 'undefined+undefined' in the admin list.
(Applied by testing agent) CreateOrderDialog setRow was rewritten to a functional setState — main agent should review the fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.jsx line 97 and keep it.
critical_code_review_comments: helpers.compute_scheme: when both free_qty and special_price schemes match, the returned scheme_id/scheme_name/scheme_label reflect only the free_qty scheme (special-price info is only exposed via unit_price). Frontend must render offers from variant.active_schemes rather than order.items.scheme_label to show BOTH offers on the product page — the API supports this (verified) but any UI that shows only line.scheme_label will hide the special-price offer text.
AdminSchemes row Type/Rule ternary does not handle 'case_price' — will render as free_qty branch (see action_items).

CreateOrderDialog originally used non-functional setState in setRow — pattern should be avoided across the codebase to prevent similar stale-closure regressions (e.g. any component doing setState(a); setState(b) synchronously that both read from the same rendered state).
orders.py admin_create_order/edit_order do not validate mobile/pincode/state format — accepts empty strings. Fine for admin flow but consider Pydantic model for safety.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested flows after setRow fix

rca of the issue: Admin Create Order UI was silently broken (product select value never stuck): CreateOrderDialog defined setRow as `set('items', form.items.map(...))` where `set` used a functional setForm updater but `form.items.map(...)` was evaluated against the closure's snapshot. The product Select's onValueChange fired setRow twice synchronously (product_id, then variant_id=''); React batched both setForm calls, and because the second's newItems was computed from the original snapshot (product_id still empty), it overwrote the first. Reproduction: open /admin/orders → Create Order → Add Product → pick any product → UI shows 'Product' placeholder still. Mitigation applied: rewrote setRow to `setForm(f => ({...f, items: f.items.map(...)}))` so each functional update composes on top of the pending state. Retested — order created, appears in list, delete works.
